name: Kimi ga Kawaru Tame no Susume
original_name: 君が変わるためのススメ
source:
To avoid burdening her family, our heroine starts a part-time job while studying at university.
She hears from her mother that her younger brother is dropping out of school and is without work, and then... "I'm so sorry but I will be reducing your allowance. I hope you understand..."

A sudden, unexpected supply line disruption... With her already small allowance reduced even further, she's at a loss at to what to do. This is when Tomatsu, a university faculty member, approaches her.
"I was wondering if you would mind helping some students lose weight?"
The chance to have her food expenses paid for in exchange for the part-time work is a dream opportunity, so she accepts the proposal right away. However, it seems the dieters in question will present formibable challenges:
A student studying literature who received a complaint for breaking a library chair after sitting on it...
A student athlete at risk of needing to repeat a year because he put on weight...

On top of that, could it be that each of the boys she meets on the job—Tomatsu, Akutagawa and Takuto—all have their own problems too...?
What will she learn about the boys' pasts and the problems they currently face...?

[From [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/story]product page[/url]]
translation:
为了不增加家里的负担，女主人公在读大学的同时开始兼职。
母亲告诉她，弟弟辍学后也没找工作，接着又说：“真对不起，不过家里得减少给你的生活费了。希望你能理解……”

突如其来的补给中断……原本就不多的生活费再次缩水，让她不知所措。这时，大学职员户松向她提出了邀请。
“能不能请你帮几位学生减肥？”
兼职就能解决伙食费，简直是梦寐以求的机会，她立刻答应。然而，需要减肥的对象，似乎个个都很棘手：
一位文学专业学生，因为坐坏图书馆椅子而被投诉……
一位体育生，因发胖而面临留级危机……

不仅如此，她在工作中遇见的男生们——户松、芥川与拓斗——似乎也各有烦恼……？
她会了解到他们怎样的过去，以及如今面临的难题呢……？

[摘自[url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/story]作品页面[/url]]
